node.statement: Bilinearity gives U bold-dot S-U bold-dot U^dagger=U bold-dot(S-U^dagger). By node 1.1, epsilon_r<=1/64, and by node 1.2, ||U||<=2. Thus the product-norm axiom and node 1.7.2.1 yield ||U bold-dot S-U bold-dot U^dagger||<=(1+epsilon_r)||U|| ||S-U^dagger||<=(65/64)*2*84*epsilon_r=(1365/8)*epsilon_r<171*epsilon_r.
